import sys

MOD = 998244353

def enumFIF(n, mod):
    f = [0] * (n + 1)
    invf = [0] * (n + 1)
    f[0] = 1
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        f[i] = (f[i - 1] * i) % mod
    a = f[n]
    b = mod
    p, q = 1, 0
    while b > 0:
        c = a // b
        a, b = b, a % b
        p, q = q, p - c * q
    invf[n] = p % mod
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        invf[i] = (invf[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % mod
    return [f, invf]

def C(n, r, mod, fif):
    if n < 0 or r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return (fif[0][n] * fif[1][r] % mod) * fif[1][n - r] % mod

def pow_mod(a, n, mod):
    ret = 1
    while n > 0:
        if n & 1:
            ret = (ret * a) % mod
        a = (a * a) % mod
        n >>= 1
    return ret

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    K = int(data[1])
    L = int(data[2])
    mod = MOD
    fif = enumFIF(10000, mod)
    muls = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(K, n + 1):
        m = C(n, i, mod, fif)
        for j in range(i, n + 1):
            sign = 1 if ((j - i) & 1) == 0 else -1
            muls[j] = (muls[j] + m * C(n - i, n - j, mod, fif) * sign) % mod
    ans = 0
    for i in range(K, n + 1):
        term = pow_mod(2, i, mod) * fif[0][i] % mod
        term = term * fif[0][i] % mod
        term = term * fif[1][2 * i + 1] % mod
        term = term * muls[i] % mod
        ans = (ans + term) % mod
    ans = (ans * L) % mod
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
